title: Pure Lyrilusc
summary: Lyrilusc cards only, with generic Links and staples. Lyriluscs are Level 1 WIND Winged Beasts that swarm into Rank 1 Xyz Monsters and give them extra effects as material. Lyrilusc - Turquoise Warbler summons itself onto an empty board and brings another Lyrilusc, Sapphire Swallow summons itself with another Level 1, and Cobalt Sparrow searches a Level 1 Winged Beast. Lyrilusc - Bird Call adds or mills a Lyrilusc and summons another. Celestine Wagtail searches a Lyrilusc Spell/Trap and attaches itself from the GY. Lyrilusc - Assembled Nightingale attacks once per material and protects the Lyriluscs. Ensemblue Robin bounces their Special Summons. Lyrilusc - Bird Strike negates every monster they control. Beryl Canary limits the Extra Deck to Xyz for the turn.
main: Searches a Level 1 Winged Beast when Special Summoned.
Summons itself with another Level 1 Winged Beast from the hand.
Summons itself onto an empty board; brings another Lyrilusc.
Searches a Lyrilusc Spell/Trap; attaches itself to a Lyrilusc Xyz.
Revives a Lyrilusc with itself from the hand.
Adds or mills a Lyrilusc, then summons another.
Negates every face-up monster they control.
Stacks one Xyz onto another; draws with three materials.
Sets their ATK to your Lyrilusc's and their Levels/Ranks to 1.
